title: How Well Does Mathematical Reasoning Transfer Across Languages in English-Centric LLMs?
abstract: arXiv:2510.02272v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Post-Training (RPT) have substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but it remains unclear how well such gains transfer across languages. In this work, we study cross-lingual mathematical reasoning transfer in English-centric LLMs under controlled multilingual evaluation. We first evaluate a range of English-centric reasoning models on multilingual mathematical reasoning benchmarks and find that transfer is highly variable across initial model choice, target language, and training paradigm. Through controlled comparative experiments, we further find that stronger English-centric initialization does not necessarily lead to stronger relative transfer efficiency, even when it yields higher multilingual reasoning accuracy. Finally, we show that the largest improvement comes from moving beyond English-only supervision: adding a single parallel language y

translated_title: 数学推理在以英语为中心的大语言模型中跨语言迁移的效果如何？
translated_abstract: 强化后训练的最新进展已显著提升了大型语言模型（LLM）的数学推理能力，但这些能力在多大程度上能够跨语言迁移仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们在受控的多语言评测条件下研究了以英语为中心的大语言模型中的跨语言数学推理迁移。我们首先在多语言数学推理基准上评估了一系列以英语为中心的推理模型，发现迁移效果在初始模型选择、目标语言和训练范式之间存在高度差异。通过受控对比实验，我们进一步发现，更强的以英语为中心的初始模型并不一定带来更强的相对迁移效率，即使它能产生更高的多语言推理准确率。最后，我们表明最大的提升来自于超越仅使用英语监督的做法：添加一种平行语言（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究系统评估了以英语为中心的大语言模型的跨语言数学推理迁移，发现迁移效果受初始模型、目标语言和训练范式的影响差异显著，且更强的英语初始化未必带来更高的迁移效率，而引入单一平行语言监督能带来最大提升。
en_tdlr: This study systematically examines cross-lingual mathematical reasoning transfer in English-centric LLMs, finding that transfer varies highly across initial models, target languages, and training paradigms; stronger English initialization does not guarantee better relative transfer efficiency, and adding a single parallel language beyond English-only supervision yields the largest improvement.
